title: A parent or student
summary: Small-group classes, foundational reasoning, and daily practice tests. Or take the short entrance baseline diagnostic.

title: A graduate who wants to teach
summary: Teach one class a day while preparing for your own examination. Receive a reserved library desk, certified teaching hours, and the tutor.

title: A reader
summary: Access the quiet desks, reference collections, and reading rooms of the Knowledge Commons when reader cards open.

title: A founder or builder
summary: Desks and community on the top floor in return for mentoring and teaching children. Agreed per founder.

title: A district partner
summary: Bring a Synapse Circle to your district. Each centre rooted in its district with local space and community.
